description: This file defines the ControllerClientBuilder interface and its implementation SimpleControllerClientBuilder, providing methods to create and manage Kubernetes controller clients and discovery clients with configurable settings.

classes.name: ControllerClientBuilder
classes.description: Interface for obtaining Kubernetes controller clients and discovery clients.

classes.name: SimpleControllerClientBuilder
classes.description: Implementation of ControllerClientBuilder that returns fixed clients with customizable user agents.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Returns a client configuration with a specified user agent.

methods.name: ConfigOrDie
methods.description: Returns a client configuration or terminates the process on error.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Creates a Kubernetes clientset interface from the configuration.

methods.name: ClientOrDie
methods.description: Creates a clientset interface or terminates the process on error.

methods.name: DiscoveryClient
methods.description: Returns a discovery client with high burst and QPS settings.

methods.name: DiscoveryClientOrDie
methods.description: Returns a discovery client or terminates the process on error.
